crop.convention: hero px = (original px - [x0, 0]) * scale; full height kept, 21.3 px trimmed off each side; Lanczos; JPEG q93 4:4:4

hero.note: His exact render, no AI. Start frame of every floor clip.

heroDayNote: Skipped on purpose: gal-11 (day) is NOT the same camera as gal-12. Edge-based ECC finds about 3 percent scale and 25-35 px shift (homography cc 0.70 vs identity 0.42), so an identical crop would not line up.

stage.shadow: alpha blurred 70 px offset (15,48) at 55 percent + 10 px offset (3,10) at 50 percent, colour #030710
stage.fit: model fitted into 0.64W x 0.80H, centred at (0.425W, 0.53H): left of centre, room for the right panel
